active_release_candidate.purpose: Retire the 0.1.23 marked shared-schema Video fallback that could briefly show a Video checkbox on foreign model cards, and replace it with strict object-scoped delivery: plugin rows hidden by default in the shared schema, a three-boundary compiled-asset patch, and a runtime component bridge that adapts only the concrete model-card objects of the two plugin-owned Source types.

current_goal.goal: Keep the native per-model-card Video capability on the two plugin-owned Source types while making foreign model cards untouched at every layer: shared schema, served Dashboard assets, live dialog components, save boundary, and persisted config. Prefer the compiled-asset private-clone bridge when all three structural boundaries match; the injected runtime component bridge adapts concrete owned dialog objects when the bundle differs. The 0.1.23 shared-schema fallback is retired.
non_goals: Do not restore the 0.1.23 marked shared-schema Video fallback or any global modalities injection.
Do not restore the retired Provider Source master switch or Source model selector.
Do not replace the native model-card modalities Video selection with a custom request field or hidden Boolean.
Do not delete or simplify the 0.1.19+ per-model request fields, audio path, compressed/original video quality, Agent Plan channel, migration logic, or request overrides while fixing UI delivery.
Do not let a foreign Provider card display, persist, or act on a plugin Video option or any volcengine_* field.
Do not remove a future AstrBot-native Video modality merely because the plugin adds the same option value to owned cards.
Do not claim 0.1.24 runtime publication or a real user installation until the publisher and external reinstall are directly observed.

observed: The 0.1.24 candidate removes the marked shared-schema Video fallback added by 0.1.23. Plugin model-field rows are contributed hidden in the shared schema and revealed only on owned private dialog clones or owned live component instances.

The compiled-asset bridge now requires three structural boundaries in the same served bundle (private model-card metadata clone, concrete new-card data builder, host checkbox-label renderer) and adds the native video option, default field values, and a localized fifth label only for owned Source types.

The new dashboard runtime bridge injects a small script through the host index resolver. It waits for one concrete AstrBotConfig model-card component, resolves ownership only through iterable.provider_source_id -> Provider Source type from the authenticated /api/v1/providers/schema response, and mutates only that card's ordinary reactive data/private metadata. Foreign dialogs are never selected or mutated.

Real Source-Type Video Differential run 31852045657 and Real Cross-Provider Plugin Effect Matrix run 31852045661 passed on AstrBot 4.27.3 with real credentials: owned Ark cards gain Video while foreign OpenAI/xAI/Gemini cards keep their four native modalities and no plugin rows.

Model-card Video Contract run 31852048201, Model-card Lifecycle Contract run 31852048202, Runtime Distribution Gate run 31852048206, and 0.1.19 Compatibility Baseline Dashboard Regression run 31852048207 all passed on the candidate branch.

Real DeepSeek Foreign Differential run 31912600006 passed on the candidate tree: a real DeepSeek Source fetched through the workflow preflight, its unsaved and saved/reopened model cards showed only the four native modalities with no Video and no volcengine_* rows, the persisted config kept the $DEEPSEEKAPI environment reference with no secret value, and AstrBot's provider test endpoint completed a real remote request (867 ms).
The 0.1.23 stable baseline is preserved: main is 699a52f36d140d2acecb79801c0071ce50ae8c4e and the published runtime branch is b8d15630f0b97d2c4374d5f232fce4a9833e2925, both carrying metadata 0.1.23.
All thirteen packaged unit/contract test scripts pass on the candidate tree against a real AstrBot runtime.

stable_boundaries: AstrBot owns provider lifecycle, routing, fallback, retry, model-card management, and the base shared Dashboard schema.
The plugin adapts Volcengine request and media protocols; it does not maintain a second global model-capability database.
The user-facing Video truth remains the native per-model-card modalities selection. The precise UI path scopes it to the two plugin-owned Source types after a private dialog clone exists.

No shared-schema Video injection exists anymore. The native video option may only be added on concrete model-card objects of the two plugin-owned Source types, via the private dialog clone (asset bridge) or the live component instance (runtime bridge). Foreign dialogs must never receive it, and the create/update save boundary strips any forged value.
Future AstrBot-native Video support is host-owned and must not be deleted by plugin cleanup.
Request transport settings are not permanent model-capability facts.

The 0.1.19+ rich per-model request fields, audio path, video quality modes, Agent Plan routing, migrations, and request override semantics are compatibility baseline behavior unless a separate validated change explicitly replaces them.
Development documentation, tests, evidence, and experiments stay outside the allow-list runtime package.
A passing gate proves only the object and layer named by that gate; real source-type differential, persistence, runtime behavior, and unload/release evidence remain distinct checks.
warning: Read verdict first, then docs/contracts/MODEL_CARD_VIDEO_CONTRACT.md for any Video/modalities/Provider-UI task.
